species.tagline: A fish that walks on the mud

tasks.title: Look at its eyes
tasks.message: Its eyes sit on top of its head, so it can see above the water.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a mudskipper. Its eyes sit right on top of its head.

tasks.title: It can walk
tasks.message: It props itself up on its front fins and walks — and hops — across the mud.
tasks.subtitle: It props itself up on its front fins and walks on the mud. A fish out of water!

tasks.title: Help it
tasks.message: Clean mudflats at Mai Po are where mudskippers live.
tasks.subtitle: Clean mudflats are where mudskippers live. Thank you!
